THE LINE-1/LINE-2 BASIS RULE: this is the 4-line form, so Form A itemizes only line 1 (donors above $50) and the residual against the published stated_total_contributions would be line 2 - but here line 2 (the <=$50 aggregate) is also printed '-', a NIL MARK, so there is no residual at all and no unitemized remainder to explain. Per the zero-glyph ruling the '-' cells stay BLANK, never 0. No in-kind rows are labelled, so both in-kind conventions give the same figure.

escalation_note: Seven crops. THREE were exploratory and are the reason this filing took longer than its 16 rows suggest: both schedules are rotated sheets on which the ROWS RUN RIGHT-TO-LEFT in the rendered page (row 1 is at the RIGHT edge, next to the header strip), which no other filing in this chunk does, and my first two probes at the left-hand bands came back blank because I had assumed the usual left-to-right order. A full-width strip crop of the amount column (pct:0,80,100,20@p2) settled the orientation by showing all eleven amounts descending right-to-left. FOUR were A3 proofs, two per schedule page: p2 row 1 rendered '$500.00' and row 11 rendered '$150'; p3 row 1 rendered '$1,000.00' and row 5 rendered '$2,367.20'. No legibility escalation was needed - both sides closed exactly on the first full-page read.

3.measure_note: ROTATED LANDSCAPE Form A: text reads bottom-to-top and the table's ROWS advance ALONG X, so axis='x' - COLUMN bands are the horizontal rules and ROW bands the vertical ones. CRITICAL AND UNUSUAL: the rows run RIGHT-TO-LEFT. Row 1 is v_rules[22..23] = [79.74,82.91], hard against the header/hatched strip at the right edge, and each later row sits one band FURTHER LEFT; the general rule for this sheet is row n = v_rules[23-n .. 24-n]. Only the 5 used rows are stored. The amount column band [84.81,95.0] is hand-measured (the h_rules on this page are mostly the rotated text's own dark runs and cannot be read as a grid), so cells claims that one measured column only. PROOF (A3): pct:79.74,84.81,3.17,10.2@p3 rendered '$1,000.00' (row 1) and pct:67.12,84.81,3.2,10.2@p3 rendered '$2,367.20' (row 5) - the recorded first and last amounts, which also confirms the right-to-left direction rather than assuming it.

2.measure_note: Same rotated geometry and the same RIGHT-TO-LEFT row order on Form B: row n = v_rules[23-n .. 24-n], so row 1 = [77.86,80.92] and row 11 = [47.18,50.23]. The 27 detected v_rules are a clean, evenly pitched (~3.06 pct) row grid covering the sheet's 26 printed rows; only the 11 used rows are stored, and the header strip and shaded spacer (the bands right of 80.92) are excluded. The amount column band [86.06,96.5] is anchored on the one clean h_rule at 86.06 plus a hand-measured table edge. PROOF (A3): pct:77.86,86.06,3.06,10.4@p2 rendered '$500.00' (row 1) and pct:47.18,86.06,3.05,10.4@p2 rendered '$150' (row 11).
